DOW.notes: Dow Chemical (DOW) merged with DuPont to form DowDuPont (DWDP) Sep 2017; Dow Inc. spun off as DOW Apr 2019. Alias chain stitches the three segments.

aliases.note: Old Dow Chemical Co., traded as DOW until DowDuPont merger close.
DowDuPont Inc., formed from Dow Chemical + DuPont merger.
Dow Inc., materials-sciences spin-off from DowDuPont.

WBA.notes: Renamed from WAG in Dec 2014; delisted from NYSE in 2025 after going private. Registry url_override fetches the full CC0 adjusted-close history.
